kaikki_vikisozluk.e: اِسْلَنْطَعَ • (islanṭaʕa) IIIq (non-past يَسْلَنْطِعُ (yaslanṭiʕu), verbal noun اِسْلِنْطَاع (islinṭāʕ))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From the root س ل ط ع (s l ṭ ʕ); possibly related to سَلْطَعُون (salṭaʕūn, “crab, crayfish”).
s: س ل ط ع (s l ṭ ʕ)
g: to lie down on one's back
